Fix every fresh connector container crashing at import with `IndexError: 2`. The entrypoint located its committed `image_requirements.txt` via `Path(__file__).parents[2]`, which is out of range when Modal re-imports the entrypoint from its automatic file mount at `/root/app.py` -- so any newly booted container (fresh env deploys, cold boots after the image-pinning change landed) died before serving and deploy health checks failed. The entrypoint now uses `locate_image_requirements` from modal_app_kit, an upward search that never raises (the placeholder it returns in-container is never read; the image is already built there).
